subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Default Organ Donation
description: A quick win: understand Default Organ Donation.

hook.text: Austria has 99% organ donor consent. Germany has 12%. The countries are neighbors.

buildup.text: Default effects in organ donation save thousands of lives. When the default is yes, almost nobody opts out.

discovery.text: Default Organ Donation reveals the behavioral mechanism driving the outcome.

twist.text: Mandated choice is a middle path. Everyone must choose yes or no when renewing a license.

climax.text: Default Organ Donation matters because better design changes real decisions.

punchline.text: The default saves more lives than any campaign ever could.

quiz.question: Why does Austria have 99% organ donor consent compared to Germany's 12%?
options: Austrians are more altruistic than Germans
Austria uses opt-out while Germany uses opt-in defaults
Austria pays organ donors but Germany does not
